title: Always Together
about: The friendship that grew between Lauren, Will, and me as the three Tech ADs who seemed to go everywhere and handle everything together.
description: This track reflects on the friendship Lauren, Will, and I built while working together as the three Tech ADs. Long days were filled with morning shows, responsibilities, unexpected problems, and one task immediately leading into another. Without deliberately trying to become a team, we gradually became the three people who were almost always found together. Looking back, the work is only part of what remains. The stronger memory is the laughter between tasks, the challenges we handled side by side, and the friendship that grew out of simply being there together day after day.
lyrics: Three Tech ADs with somewhere to be,
If you found one, you'd find all three.
The days were busy from the start,
Working side by side became an art.
They're built one long day at a time.
Until the rhythm feels just right.
Always one step from the next.
If there was work, we'd all be there,
If there was laughter, we'd all join in.
Some friendships grow because of time...
Ours grew because of where we'd been.
Helping where we could each day.
Three more waiting on the way.
There wasn't much time left to stop,
Or wonder where the hours went.
To see what all that time had meant.
What we'd never stopped to see.
One by one without us knowing.
The strongest parts of some summers
Are simply who you make them with.
The week kept pulling us forward,
We just found our own way.
When I think back on that summer...
I don't just remember the work.
I remember the three of us.
